name: The Tanager
notes: A survey cutter, dead four months. The crew sealed themselves into the reactor annex and did not come out. Whatever they were running from is still in the hold.

zones.name: Docking Collar
zones.look: A short umbilical, frost on every surface. The inner hatch stands open on a dark corridor.
zones.note: Safe. Nothing comes this far forward.

finds.text: The hatch is wedged with a fire axe, from this side. Somebody wanted it to stay open behind them.

finds: A crew manifest: eleven names, four struck through in pen.

zones.name: Spinal Corridor
zones.look: The ship's length in one straight run, handrails on both sides, half the ceiling panels hanging.
zones.note: Noise here carries to the hold. Advance the Threat Clock on anything loud.

finds.text: The panels didn't fall. They were pushed out from inside the ceiling void, one after another, heading aft.

finds: A dropped toolkit, one charge left.

zones.name: Mess Deck
zones.look: Tables bolted down, trays still on them. Someone ate here in a hurry and did not clear up.
zones.note: Nothing lives here, but it's the room the crew will want to regroup in. Let them.

finds.text: Eleven places laid, seven eaten. The last four trays are untouched and the chairs are still pushed in.

finds: Three Food Units in a sealed locker, and a bottle of something strong.

zones.name: Medical Bay
zones.look: Two berths, one with the restraints cut through from the inside.
zones.note: The room that explains the hold. Hand over the restraints freely; make them work for the chart.

finds.text: The restraints were cut from the inside, and not with a blade. The edges are melted.
A patient chart: Wyre, J. Surveyor. Admitted with a puncture wound taken in the hold. Treated, sedated, and then the entries stop mid-sentence.

finds: A Medkit and two doses of something unlabelled.

zones.name: Reactor Annex
zones.look: A pressure door with a handwritten sign taped to it, and behind that, warmth.
zones.note: Four bodies, sat down, no injuries. They suffocated politely. Only reachable by breaching the weld.

finds.text: Four bodies, sat down against the bulkhead, no injuries on any of them. They arranged themselves.
The reactor log, last entry: we have sealed ourselves in and vented the rest of the ship. If you are reading this, do not open the hold. It is not Wyre any more.

finds: Two Power Cells and the reactor log.

zones.name: Bridge
zones.look: Consoles dark but for one amber telltale, and a chair turned to face the door.
zones.note: The beacon is the hook for whatever brought the crew here. Let them switch it off if they want.

finds.text: The amber telltale is a distress beacon, still transmitting on a channel nobody has monitored in decades.
The command chair is turned away from the consoles to face the door, and the lockout was set from this seat.

finds: Navigational charts for three systems, and a sidearm in the captain's locker.

zones.name: Cargo Hold
zones.look: Two decks of open space, netting torn down, containers moved into a rough wall at the far end.
zones.note: Start the creature here, behind the container wall. It knows the crawlway and the crew do not.

finds.text: The containers were dragged into a wall from this side, and the netting came down to make the gap behind it soft. Something built that.

finds: Scrap Metal and Scrap Components in quantity, if there's time to cut it free.

zones.name: Maintenance Crawl
zones.look: A duct a person fits through on their elbows, running the length of the ship.
zones.note: The creature's road. Anyone in here alone when it uses the crawl has a very bad turn.

finds.text: The dust is disturbed the whole length of the duct, in both directions, more times than one passage would account for.

borders.note: The inner hatch, wedged open with a fire axe.
A privacy door, shut but not locked.
Welded from the inside. The sign reads DO NOT OPEN.
The bulkhead buckled inward and the frame has dropped.
A wall panel kicked out from the duct side.
The duct ends over a two-deck drop into the netting.
